title: Manufacturing and Commercial Uses
previewText: For manufacturing and commercial uses, the accessory off-street parking and loading regulations of the designated M1 District, as set forth in Article IV, Chapter 4 (Accessory Off-street Parking and Loading Regulations), shall apply.
